name: SignalWall
one_line: A free, open-source, typography-first live wallpaper system for calm Windows multi-monitor desks.
funding_focus: Kickstarter and GoFundMe are the current public support links. GitHub remains the technical source of truth for code, security notes, and releases.
features: Same or different quote across screens
Adjustable timing, particles, grid opacity, motion, and progress bar
Source-first install and release verification documentation
public_identity_guidance: Use SignalWall by Nestcells for public-facing mentions. Do not expose personal founder details unless explicitly provided by the founder.
